observed_strengths.finding: Large persistent MOVE/FIRE and contextual hold control made two-contact actions possible.
Route markings, planning overview, APPROACH/RECOVER labels and recovered-name checks made objectives learnable. Planning remained open until visibly closed.
Numbered coil percentages/OFF feedback and uplink progress give clear mission progression.
Rain, cyan lighting, wet ground reflections and industrial relay composition create a coherent mood at this viewport.

observed_frictions.finding: Rear threat acquisition required multiple turn corrections; attention split between receiver holds and attacks led to shield damage.
Moving patrol tap failed to acquire on first try; subsequent correction and reload prolonged exposure. Cause of first miss uncertain (movement, geometry or aim behavior).
Small text in map legend/prompts, dark structures and stacked UI demand deliberate inspection at 844x390. A large threat cue overlapped the left-side guard near the Heart in attempt 2.
Coil armor/open timing and reload meant extra firing batches; no causal conclusion about pause benefits or human timing.

scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 mixed with substantial friction; 7 good observed experience with meaningful limitations/friction; 10 exceptional and consistently clear. Subjective review of observed emulated sessions, not win-rate grading or hardware certification. Overall is holistic, not arithmetic.

reasons.overall_mobile: Coherent atmosphere, understandable objective chain and usable touch assists, tempered by target acquisition corrections, attention competition and limited continuous-control evidence. Two wins alone do not determine score.
reasons.controls: Two-contact move/fire drag worked; manual swipe and DASH activation observed. Moving target required correction. Physical thumb comfort, continuous holds, zoom and tools not assessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, coil phases and deck defense provide observable progression and threats; route assistance helped travel. Limited manual combat and interruptions constrain challenge/flow assessment.
reasons.presentation: Consistent rain-lit industrial setting and restrained cyan/amber feedback; audio and hardware rendering quality unassessed.
reasons.usability: Map, objective checks, contextual holds, automatic reload and explicit START FRESH supported completion. Label transitions required learning; threats during holds divided attention.
reasons.readability: Large health/ammo and target/coil feedback read clearly; small secondary text, dark scenery and overlapping cues reduced glance clarity.

unassessed: Continuous enjoyment and uninterrupted combat flow
Successful phase evade or DASH charge escape

method.tools: Only helper --help read; visible screenshots and native JSON-lines two-contact gestures. No game source, tests, docs, prior reviews, recordings, hidden state or target metadata inspected.
method.observation: Each screenshot viewed separately before dependent adaptive input; one new scene target per batch; anchored FIRE followed tap where used. Every wait <=3000ms, within requested 12000ms ceiling. Auto boundaries respected; requested/executed waits logged.
method.scope: Exactly two fresh terminal attempts. No checkpoint retry, third attempt, build, commit, server change, publication or agents.
